repair_provenance.repair: Retain all consecutive transitions for training; score only frozen 2004-2025 target years.

interpretation: After stable transect identity and own previous-year state are included, neither leave-one-node-out bay-segment state nor finer previous-year neighborhood deviation adds supported next-year information for focal frequency or Braun-Blanquet state. Annual quantitative dynamics therefore appear strongly site-local at these scales; this does not identify the local causal driver.
claim_boundary: Post-hoc exploratory ecology motivated by already-consumed Tampa and EOG results.
Failure of segment/neighborhood increments does not prove ecological independence among transects.
The result does not exclude common environmental forcing that is asynchronous, nonlinear, event-scale, or poorly represented by previous-year state means.
Node identity is a saturated reference, not a measured habitat mechanism.
Do not tune the frozen EOG radii or support rule to rescue a spatial effect.
